lines.en: I walk with heavy steps and very broad shoulders.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，每一步都压着地面。
lines.en: I move slowly, each step pressing the ground.

lines.zh: 我穿过这片湿地，水被推开。
lines.en: I walk through the marsh and the water parts.
I walk toward you and will not stop.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很重，像拉着风箱。
lines.en: My breathing is heavy, like a bellows.

lines.zh: 我抬手拨开挡路的枝条。
lines.en: I push aside the branches in my way.

lines.zh: 我迈开腿，水沟在脚下过。
lines.en: I stride and the ditch passes underfoot.
I go around the gravel without shortening my pace.
There is no hesitation in my walk.

lines.zh: 我在你身边停下，又走开。
lines.en: I stop beside you, then walk on.

lines.zh: 我站着，水从肩上滴下来。
lines.en: I stand while water drips from my shoulders.
I look down at the ground.
My hand has not opened.

lines.zh: 我听着水下的每一点响动。
lines.en: I listen to every stir beneath the water.
I raise an arm to the light.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整块石头盖住了。
lines.en: My shadow covers the entire stone.
I am listening to what moves underwater.
I am still, but always awake.

lines.zh: 我把湿透的衣角拧了一下。
lines.en: I wring out a soaked hem.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看见远处有光。
lines.en: I raise my head and see light far off.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己是走还是留。
lines.en: I do not know whether to go or stay.
I turn slowly in place.
Things still drip off me.
I stand there, looking at no one.
I push wet hair from my face.
I am weighing whether it is worth a fight.
I lower my eyes to you.
You are standing there and have not backed off.
I neither smile nor bellow.

lines.zh: 我又近了一步，水没过脚面。
lines.en: One step closer; water covers my feet.
You are a head shorter than me.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指节还在滴水。
lines.en: I raise a hand, knuckles still dripping.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，眼睛没有躲。
lines.en: Your eyes did not flinch from mine.
I raise a hand and point at you.

lines.zh: 水里那几个，是你带来的吧。
lines.en: Those in the water, did you bring them?
I stand here; the path ends.
When the crowd grows, I back toward the water.

lines.zh: 我闻到你袖口滴下的咸水。
lines.en: I smell salt water dripping from your cuff.
I give half a step and water splashes.
That had weight.
I press the wound without a sound.
I raise my head, my gaze heavier.
My breathing broke for a moment.
The blood thins in the water.
I steady and square up.
You fight better than I assumed.
I draw my arm back.
I am taking your measure again.
I do not put that in my mouth.
You keep this one.
I stopped living on such things long ago.
Does your arm not tire holding that up?
I have no use for such a thing.
That buys nothing from me.
I turned my head aside.
I want something else.
This food will not fill me.
Take it and step back.
You hit me and my foot does not shift.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挡，你就退开了。
lines.en: I raise an arm and you fall back.
My body is heavy.
That hurt you, not me.
I did not throw a single blow back.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看你，又抬起来。
lines.en: I look down at you, then up again.
The water splashes where I plant my feet.
I move one step to the side.
Do not press up this close to me.
My shoulder shoves you aside.
I will not discuss that with you.
My mind is on other things.
I turn my back to you.
That is not mine to answer.
I shook my head once.
You are asking the wrong sort of person.
I would rather not take that up.
I turn my eyes to the water.
I have nothing to say to that.
I turned and walked off.
I bend, pick it up, and look.
This does not belong to me.
I hold it, then set it down.
I stuffed it into my wet robe.
It is light as a strip of peel.
I hand it back to you.
There is another on the ground.
I set it on the stone.
I have no use for this.
I look a long time and say nothing.
I stop and turn my face to you.
The water starts to churn upward.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，那根东西亮了一下。
lines.en: I raise my arm and the thing in it glints.
I step forward and the water splashes.
I do not ask your reasons.
Your foot moved; so did I.
My breathing deepens.
I plant my feet.
A ring of ripples breaks on the water.
Run; I'll be waiting at the water's edge.
I fix on you; my foot sinks.
My shoulders begin to glow.
This time I will not wait.
I lowered myself down.
I bring my arm across.
You had better stay rooted.
The ground here is already wet.
I raise my eyes to you.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，泥就陷下去。
lines.en: With each step, the mud gives way.
You change course and I change with you.

lines.zh: 我的步子不快，你甩不掉。
lines.en: I am not fast, but you cannot shake me.
The water divides under my feet.
I drive you toward the bank.
I raise a hand against the light.

lines.zh: 我慢慢收拢，不给你空隙。
lines.en: I close in slowly, leaving no gap.

lines.zh: 石头挡不住我，我知道你在。
lines.en: The rock hides nothing; I know you're there.

lines.zh: 我绕过去，路更长也不怕。
lines.en: I go around; a longer way does not trouble me.

lines.zh: 我挡住光，你就在我影里。
lines.en: I block the light; you stand in my shadow.
You are counting my steps.
Every step is closer.
I raise my arm a little.
The water starts to bubble.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音我听见了。
lines.en: I hear you gasping.
At this range, walking suffices.

lines.zh: 我把你堵在石头和水之间。
lines.en: I have you between the stone and the water.
Only the last few steps remain.
I have raised my arm.
Step back again and you are in the water.

lines.zh: 我挥臂砸下去，水花炸开。
lines.en: I swing my arm down and the water bursts.
It lands on your shoulder.
I sweep my arm across.

lines.zh: 他们叫我棍母，不是白叫的。
lines.en: They call me Mother of the Baton for a reason.
I pin you and press down.
Current runs out along the water.
I did not let up once.
This is only the beginning.
I catch your blow on my arm.
The hit drives you back three paces.

lines.zh: 我一肩顶过去，你就下水了。
lines.en: One shoulder shove and you're in the water.
Fewer get up again.
My arm is still crackling.
I stopped and did not pursue.
A shadow rises on the water.

lines.zh: 我先露出肩膀，然后是头。
lines.en: My shoulders surface first, then my head.

lines.zh: 我先露出背，再露出全身。
lines.en: First my back, then all of me rises.

lines.zh: 水顺着我的身体往下淌。
lines.en: Water runs down my body.
The air here has grown heavy.

lines.zh: 我站直的时候，比旁边的石头还高。
lines.en: Standing, I am taller than the stones beside me.
I raise a hand and wipe my face.

lines.zh: 水里那些东西都散开了。
lines.en: The things in the water scatter.
I stop at the bank.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在很远都听得见。
lines.en: My breathing carries a long way.
This stretch of shore is mine.
I pull my foot out of the mud.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看着陆地的方向。
lines.en: I lift my head and look toward land.
It has been a long time since I came ashore.
I walk up the beach, step by step.
I know this salt smell.

lines.zh: 我停下来，先把四周看清。
lines.en: I stop and take in the surroundings.

lines.zh: 我从水里出来，水边多一道影子。
lines.en: I come out of the water; a shadow joins the shore.
I shake the water off.

lines.zh: 我站着，等第一个动的人。
lines.en: I stand and wait for the first to move.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的湿衣，我退进水里。
lines.en: Fire bakes my wet clothes; I back into the water.

lines.zh: 落地那下，我的膝盖磕在石上。
lines.en: On landing, my knee strikes stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我蹬着往浅处走。
lines.en: Water floods in; I kick toward the shallows.
The blast throws me sliding sideways.
Something lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 一股力压住我，我用力顶回去。
lines.en: Some force bears down and I push back hard.
Hunger hollows me; my feet lose force.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我硬接了下来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I take it standing.

lines.zh: 脚下没有底，我这身重量也没用。
lines.en: There is no bottom, and my weight is useless.
